description: This file is a CMake module that locates the D-Bus client library and sets up an imported library target for use in CMake builds.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Finds the specified package, in this case 'PkgConfig'.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the availability of the specified pkg-config modules, in this case 'dbus-client'.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds the library file for 'dbus_client' with provided hints.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds the path to 'DbusClient.h' header file.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported library target for 'DBusClient::DBusClient'.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for the imported target, such as location, include directories, and link libraries.
